name: Scheduler
author: PyCmd
description: Runs a script again every so often - a backup every ten minutes, a scrape every hour - without writing a sleep loop into the script itself. Jobs live as long as the app does, and it says so rather than promising more than Android allows.

extends.title: Scheduled jobs
extends.description: Scripts that run again on a timer

commands.name: every
commands.help: every <seconds> <script> - run it again and again

guides.title: Using Scheduler
guides.summary: Run a script again on a timer, and what that does not promise.
